segments.sn52.7:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn52.7:1.4: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato anuruddhassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.sn52.7:2.1: “Cattārome, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattanti.
segments.sn52.7:2.3: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati … pe … vedanāsu … pe … citte … pe … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ – ime kho, āvuso, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvitā bahulīkatā taṇhakkhayāya saṃvattantī”ti.
